title: acriopsis javanica var. nelsoniana
intro: Acriopsis javanica var. nelsoniana, commonly known as the Nelson's Acriopsis, is a variant of the Acriopsis javanica plant, a type of succulent plant in the family Triuridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine and has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nelson's Acriopsis include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
